Risk description: Scripted workflow functions have no direct Cloud equivalent
Mitigation: Inventory scripts; rewrite priority ones with Automation or Cloud scripting; retire the rest

Risk description: Duplicate or missing user emails block user migration
Mitigation: Clean the user directory before the test migration

Risk description: Custom field sprawl slows migration and confuses users
Mitigation: Merge duplicates and delete unused fields during cleanup wave

Risk description: External tools call DC REST endpoints that change in Cloud
Mitigation: List API consumers and plan adaptation with each owner

Risk description: Business testers unavailable during test migration
Mitigation: Book testers per area at kickoff and plan a dedicated test window
